posts.title: Brouwer-Lyddane Elements
posts.description: The Brouwer-Lyddane elements are a set of "mean elements" used to describe the orbit of a spacecraft. Mean elements (as opposed to osculating elements) are used as a way to smooth out fluctuations of an orbit due to the zonal spherical harmonic terms.
